import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
import { ChakraProvider } from '@chakra-ui/react'

export default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
return (
		<ChakraProvider>
			<Component {...pageProps} />
		</ChakraProvider>
	)
}
